title: PixelKin - The Farlamp Relit (body, major)
_note: Looping body of farlamp-relit: the isles' dawn. The hymn blooms in D major (the same tune as driftholm, turned major): first line + second line on the warm lead over swelling strings and harp; then the second line again as a festival swell with the bell singing the tune an octave up and a gentle kit; a tender bridge (the relative turn); the second line returns in full and its A pickup leads back round. 84 BPM, 3/4, 40 bars, 85.7 s. The Gleam cadence (minor -> major) without a Gleam. Original (VISION.md).
